description: This file defines the SettingsGateway class responsible for managing communication with a settings API, including retrieving, updating, and deleting user settings, as well as handling user session validation.

classes.name: SettingsGateway
classes.description: A class that manages communication with the settings API, providing methods to list, get, update, and delete user settings, with session validation.

methods.name: isReadyForModification
methods.description: Checks if the user session is valid for modifications.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user object from the user provider.

methods.name: userUuid
methods.description: Getter that returns the UUID of the current user or throws an error if invalid.

methods.name: listSettings
methods.description: Fetches the list of settings for the current user.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific setting by name.

methods.name: getSubscriptionSetting
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription setting value, validating that the setting is a subscription type.

methods.name: getDoesSensitiveSettingExist
methods.description: Checks if a sensitive setting exists for the user.

methods.name: updateSetting
methods.description: Updates a setting with a new value, indicating if it is sensitive.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the class by nullifying references to the API and user provider.
